DIAGNOSIS READY: Cushing's Syndrome (likely ACTH-dependent) with secondary obstructive lung disease.

The confirmed hypercortisolism explains your respiratory symptoms, as excess cortisol weakens lung tissue and causes fluid retention, leading to the obstruction seen on your tests. The normal ACTH stimulation test suggests your adrenal glands are responding appropriately, but the underlying driver of the high cortisol needs further investigation to distinguish between a pituitary source and an adrenal tumor.
